title: Managed Database: portfolio threshold
content:
## Tier basis
Managed Database portfolio threshold is specified by contracted tier. Same-category posted pre-discount usage subtotal required within one billing entity and month for volume discount; USD decimal. Discount fraction when the portfolio threshold is met; decimal.

| Contracted tier | Portfolio threshold | Portfolio discount |
|---|---|---|
| Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore | 25000.0 | 0.025 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 4 vCore | 25000.0 | 0.03 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 8 vCore | 25000.0 | 0.035 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 16 vCore | 25000.0 | 0.04 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 32 vCore | 25000.0 | 0.045 |
| Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore | 25000.0 | 0.05 |

## Tier comparison
For portfolio threshold, Northbridge Managed Database 2 vCore and Northbridge Managed Database 64 vCore use the same declared value of 25000.0.
